name: comp-296

frames.best_why: The notification is shown largest, with the radio badge, countdown, date, Notify me button and close cross all clear.

tagline: A wide card counts down to a broadcast and offers a Notify me button.
summary: A notification for an upcoming live event. A ringed radio-wave badge leads into a short countdown and a date, with a light reminder button and an X to close.
appearance: A bordered rounded strip with a soft shadow holds a circular outlined badge with a radio icon, a bold countdown line over a small grey date, a pale filled Notify me button and a grey close cross at the right.
behaviour: Only hover states move: the button and the close cross shade when pointed at. Clicking the cross or the button has no effect, so the card stays put.
demo_content: The lines "Live in 27 hours" and "November 20 at 8:00 PM." with a Notify me button.
use_when: A site wants to flag an upcoming live event and offer a reminder sign-up.
avoid_when: All the copy is fixed and both buttons are inert, so real reminders need wiring.
customise: The countdown, date and button wording are written in the file; icon, badge and width are fixed, and the component takes no props.
weight_why: A single card with one icon and two buttons; only hover fades run.

a11y.note: The close cross is named and both buttons focus, but neither has an action and the card has no live-region role.

issues: The Notify me button has no click handler.
The close cross has no handler, so the card cannot be dismissed.
polish_why: Balanced single-row layout with a friendly badge; only the dead buttons are a flaw.
search_phrases: card saying a stream starts soon
notify me button on a popup
event notice with a date and time
small card with a radio symbol
title: Live Event Notification
